title: 2 × enemigo: robot con arma incoporada en su cuerpo

items.name: LensCannonBot
items.note: El torso entero es un cañón: tambor de acero con una gran lente de cristal en el pecho que dispara.
items.prompt:
Generate ONE 2D game enemy sprite for a dark fantasy mobile roguelite: a floating robot whose weapon is built into its own body: its torso is a squat cannon-barrel drum with a wide glowing crystal lens in the chest. Side view facing right, full body, centered, SQUARE 1:1 image. One single character only: NOT a sprite sheet, no animation frames, no variations.

ART STYLE: Dark fantasy mobile game. Colour world of a frozen cave and ice crystal theme (colours only, not materials). Cold saturated palette of deep blues, icy whites, pale blue-grey stone and frosted steel. Cyan/turquoise accents only on crystals and eyes. Painted digital illustration, stylized semi-realistic, slight texture, no grain/haze outside the character.

CHARACTER: Dark steel body, a thick rounded barrel-shaped torso with a ring of fins around the lens, small rivets, a flat visor strip above; a thruster below holds it up. A robotic floating machine, metal and mechanical (never an organic animal): it hovers because of a hover device (a thruster, jet or ring that blasts fire, vapour or energy downward). NO legs, NO feet, nothing touches the ground, it is airborne. Use the zone's colour palette only: its materials follow the creature's own nature (a robot stays metal, an animal stays an animal) and it is NOT covered in snow, ice, leaves or rock unless the design says so. It carries 1-3 glowing turquoise-cyan ice crystals: one large pale-blue crystal as the chest lens that powers the shot, two small crystal shards on top as antennae.

ATTACK: It attacks with MAGIC, but the picture shows NO weapon, NO staff, nothing held and NO spell effect: just the plain creature in its calm idle form. The part it casts with (hand, mouth, horn…) is drawn normally, closed or relaxed; a different version of that part will be drawn later to cast. Its casting part is the the round crystal lens set in the front of its chest: draw it plainly, in its idle form.

POSE (the character will be cut into separate pieces afterwards, so EVERY piece must be fully visible): Calm hovering pose, the body in the middle with the hover device clearly visible below or around it. The hover device is its own closed shape and is not hidden behind the body. Every piece of the body must be fully visible: no piece hides more than about 10% of another, and nothing covers a limb, the head or a joint. Each piece is one closed shape with its own full outline and a clearly visible contour where it touches the next one (the character is cut into separate pieces afterwards). Name sides by the image (the one on the LEFT / RIGHT of the image).

PIECES — exactly these 3, no more (no extra limbs, hands, weapons or loose parts; each piece joins its neighbour at a visible joint and has a clearly visible contour where they touch):
1. Body (torso, the machine's shell)
2. Head or sensor (only if the design has one)
3. Hover device (the thruster, jet or ring that holds it up; its flame, if any, is ONE flat colour inside its own outline)

EDGE RULES (critical):
- Clean, crisp, hard silhouette with a 2px near-black outline all around, and a slightly darker contour line where pieces meet.
- NO glow, aura, halo, bloom, particles, snow, frost mist, dust, smoke, embers, blur or soft edges outside the outline. Crystal glow stays inside the silhouette.
- ABSOLUTELY NO effects of any kind: no energy beams, no muzzle flashes, no impact bursts, no motion lines. NO cast shadows, NO ground. A flame or glow that belongs to the body is one flat color inside its own outline.
- Background: perfectly flat, uniform pure white, zero gradient or noise, even if an attached reference image has sky or scenery. The character contains no pure white fill touching the background (use pale colors).

items.name: MawDomeBot
items.note: Cabeza-cúpula con una ranura-boca brillante que es el arma; cuerpo corto y cristales a modo de cuernos.
